name: Universal Vision Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Universal Vision Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a biotech company, provides vision care services in Taiwan and China. The company offers various glasses and lenses for vision correction, contact lens solutions, and related eye care products; equipment rental and technical services for laser vision correction instruments; and technology and services for cataract and dry eye examination and treatment instruments. It also trades in medical and pharmaceutical consumables, including ophthalmic drugs, medical supplies, and consumables; and provides administrative and other professional logistics support services for cooperative clinics and eye centers, as well as brand licensing and consulting services.…
